name.title: Platform Name
name.description: Name of the platform in Homebridge.

repeatIntervalMs.title: Repeat interval (ms)
repeatIntervalMs.description: While the switch is held on, send a button press every this many ms (e.g. 200–300 for brightness/fan). Set to 0 for single press only.

fireAndForget.title: Fire and forget
fireAndForget.description: If true (default), each switch resets to Off after a press and turning Off does nothing. If false, the switch stays On until you turn it Off (no second press when turning Off).

discoverDevicesOnNetwork.title: Discover devices on network
discoverDevicesOnNetwork.description: If true, discover all ESPHome devices on the local network via mDNS (no need to list baseUrl per device). Then discovers buttons from each device. You can still add devices manually; both are merged.

devices.title: ESPHome Devices
devices.description: List of ESPHome devices (optional if discoverDevicesOnNetwork is true). Each needs baseUrl unless you only use network discovery.

name.title: Device Name
name.description: Friendly name for the device (e.g. Main Bedroom).

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the ESPHome device web server, e.g. http://mainbedroom.local or http://192.168.1.10. No trailing slash.

discoverButtons.title: Auto-discover buttons
discoverButtons.description: If true, buttons are discovered from the device at startup (no need to list them manually).

buttons.title: Buttons
buttons.description: Buttons to expose (optional if discoverButtons is true). Each appears as a switch in HomeKit.

name.title: Button Name
name.description: Display name in HomeKit (e.g. Fan on/off).

id.title: Button ID
id.description: ESPHome button object_id. If the button has no explicit id in YAML, ESPHome derives it from the name. You can set id in ESPHome for predictability, or find the id in the device's web UI.

repeatIntervalMs.title: Repeat interval (ms)
repeatIntervalMs.description: Override for this button. 0 = single press only; e.g. 200 = hold to repeat every 200ms.
